title: Restart level leaves game paused with no pause menu; game is stuck
observed: After pause then click:btn-restart, mode stays 'paused' with event 'restart', the pause menu (btn-resume, btn-restart) is not visible, and every following tick is a no-op with the state unchanged through tick 31.
expected: Restart level resets the level (score 0, 3 lives, keys 0) and the game is running again straight away, mode 'playing', with the pause menu closed.

title: Dash and step in the same tick both move the player (3 tiles)
observed: Token dash-down+down moved the player from (1,1) to (1,4): events dash, coin, move. The player dashed 2 tiles and then stepped 1 more in one tick, and the dash cooldown was set to 5.
expected: Only one move per tick: of the movement keys pressed in a tick, only the last one counts, so the player moves at most one tile (step) or one dash, not both.

title: Toast covers the pause menu's Resume button
observed: With the pause menu open after a key pickup, btn-resume reports top=false: the 'Key collected' toast sits on top of it, so a click on Resume would not reach the button.
expected: Every visible button must be clickable; nothing may cover it.

title: Keys pressed after pause in the same tick still move the player
observed: Token pause+left: the game paused, but the player still moved from (4,8) to (3,8) in that tick (events pause, move).
expected: Pause takes effect immediately; the rest of that tick's input is ignored and nothing else happens in that tick, so the player should stay at (4,8).

title: Score goes negative after spikes (-300)
observed: Score jumped from 100 to 65136 on a dash tick, then fell to -300 after spikes and a coin on a later tick, showing HUD Score -300.
expected: Score is never negative and is capped at 999,999; spikes subtract 500 but the score stops at 0. A score of 65136 from this sequence is also unexpected.

title: HUD coin counter stays stale after collecting a coin
observed: After dash-down collects a coin at tick 0, state reports coins=1 and time=299, but HUD still shows 'Coins 0/5'. The HUD coin count does not update on the tick the coin is picked up, and remains stale on the following tick.
expected: Section 8: the HUD always shows the current Coins n/5 value, so it should read 'Coins 1/5' immediately after the coin is collected.

title: Spike damage at low score wraps the score around instead of flooring at 0
observed: At tick 2 the player has score 100 and hits spikes. Score jumps to 65136 (the spike penalty of 500 wrapped to an unsigned 16-bit value, 65536-500+100). Later a coin/score update drives it to -300 at tick 5, so the score goes negative.
expected: Section 4/5: spikes cost 500 points but the score stops at 0 and never goes below it. Score must never be negative or wrap; it should read 0 after the spike hit at tick 2, not 65136.

title: HUD timer freezes at 290 while the game timer keeps counting down
observed: After pause and click:btn-resume, the state timeLeft drops (290 -> 289 -> 288 ... -> 277) but the HUD keeps showing 'Time 290' from tick 11 to the end of the run.
expected: Section 8: the HUD always shows the current Time (ticks left). After resume the HUD should track timeLeft each tick (e.g. 'Time 289', 'Time 288', ...).
